cubes.text: You're sprawled on the couch, flipping channels without much conviction. The cushion beside you sinks: your {{dad}} drops down with a sigh. A few seconds later your {{mom}} appears with two cups of coffee.
Nothing important. I was just letting the TV decide for me.
The movie playing shows a couple embracing in a parking lot under light rain. Your {{dad}} lets out a low laugh, the kind that carries memories.
Do you remember, honey, that night in the movie theater parking lot? With the storm and your soaked dress... We didn't even see half of the movie.
Your {{mom}} tenses her shoulders, her gaze darting from the screen to your {{dad}} , a mix of laughter and panic.
Hey! Don't talk about that here, we're not alone.
She gives his arm a playful slap. Your {{dad}} raises his hands, pretending to surrender, but the smile doesn't leave his face for a second.
I'm just saying that night you gave me your best smile... and something else I won't mention. Oh no, just kidding, just kidding.
Oh, shut up. You have no shame, do you?
...I think I'll go get some water.

But you don't move. You stay there, eyes fixed on the TV, ears burning, while your {{dad}} wraps his arm around your {{mom}} 's shoulders and whispers something you can't hear. She lets out a soft giggle and leans into him, still blushing. The movie continues, but your mind is already racing with mental images.
